tools.name: generate_from_image
tools.description: Turn one photo, render or drawing of an object into a textured 3D model. Paid — 30–60 credits by version (quality): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Returns a task_id; get_task shows the model when it is ready (a few minutes).

tools.name: generate_from_text
tools.description: Make a textured 3D model of one object from a text description, when there is no image. Paid — 10 credits for the internal reference picture plus the model price (30–60 credits, by quality): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Returns a task_id; get_task shows the model when it is ready

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Wait for a task_id and return its result: the finished model in the 3D viewer, or the report / files of a print, Low Poly, rig or craft job. Waits up to wait_seconds; call again while it is still running. Free: it never starts or pays for anything.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The user's library, newest first: model_id, name, preview and what was saved with each model (print checks with their verdict, crafts, game packs), plus generations in progress. search finds a model by name; has_output finds the one prepared for printing or for a craft. Free.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Show one of the user's own models in the 3D viewer by model_id, with its name, preview and link. Free.

tools.name: export_model
tools.description: Download link for a file of one of the user's models: glb, fbx, obj, usdz, stl or glb_draco. Free with a Wandy3D plan, an unlocked model or a model made with an API key; otherwise the answer names a one-time price in credits — tell the user, and only after their yes call again with pay_credits: true

tools.name: check_print
tools.description: Will this model 3D-print? Free check of one of the user's models at a chosen size: verdict (ready / review / fix) with reasons, printed size, material and print time, supports, and the repairs made to get one closed printable solid. tools.name: make_low_poly
tools.description: Make a clean Low Poly version of one of the user's models for games, AR and the web: a closed triangle mesh at a triangle target with the textures baked on, saved as a new version and shown in the 3D viewer. tools.name: rig_model
tools.description: Add a skeleton and ready-made animation clips to one of the user's models (auto-rig), saved as a new rigged version shown in the 3D viewer. Paid — 30 credits per new rig (a repeat or a failed rig is not charged): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Takes a few minutes; may return a task_

tools.name: list_animations
tools.description: The animation clips (names and seconds) of a rigged model; for a model that is not rigged, of its newest rigged version. Free.

tools.name: make_craft
tools.description: Turn one of the user's models into a craft to build by hand: papercraft (a PDF to print, cut and glue), laser (SVG layers for a laser cutter), bricks (building instructions and a parts list) or flexi (a print-in-place jointed toy; needs a rigged version from rig_model). tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: The user's own balance and plan: Wandy3D credits, or the US-dollar API balance with an API key. Free. (Prices without sign-in: get_prices.)

tools.name: browse_gallery
tools.description: Show example 3D models made with Wandy3D in the interactive 3D viewer — no sign-in, free. Lists the examples and opens one (the first, or model_id). Use it to show what the results look like before the user makes their own.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: What things cost on Wandy3D, live: a model per version, text to 3D, Low Poly, rig, crafts, files, and what a free account gets — in credits, or US dollars for an API key. No sign-in, free. (The user's own balance: get_credits.)
